items.summary: Financial recommendation: reject new CRO prototypes and site-factory admissions this cycle; authorize no new spend. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring and 21 implementation requests failed or cancelled. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the sole next implementation after the saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case is completed or closed by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. The 2026-09-21 baseline is 61 registered affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Amazon reported $4.92 aggregate commission, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for that date, but the commission is unattributed and cannot support site revenue, ROI, margin, or forecast claims. September AI spend is $997.52 across 5,522 calls; aggregate cost per call is approximately $0.18, but cost-to-learn per proposal or experiment is not calculable because AI costs are not linked to work items, experiments, or outcomes. Contribution margin, infrastructure spend, domain/hosting spend, labor cost, marketing exposure, payback, and budget variance are not calculable because those cost ledgers and approved budget limits are absent. Minimum measurement: a dated ledger keyed by site and work item containing AI, infrastructure, domain/hosting, labor, marketing, and other direct costs, plus attributable commission by tracking ID and experiment outcome. Retain only report-only finance reconciliation work; do not move money, change billing, access banking, sign contracts, or make legal or tax claims.
